laws.rule: Entrance fees for foreigners: Karak Castle JD 2 (includes the museum). (No RBA rate for JOD; at the Central Bank of Jordan rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 0.4991 JOD: JD 2 ≈ A$4.01)

local-law.note: Ministry fee table; most of these sites are also covered by the Jordan Pass.

closures: Karak Castle and Museum: Winter column (labelled November through April): 08:00-16:00; summer: 08:00-18:30; separate April-May column: 08:00-17:30; Ramadan: 09:00-17:00. The April columns overlap, so confirm the applicable seasonal timetable with the site.

Mujib Reserve: official tourism guidance describes Siq, Canyon and Malaqi as summer-only, weather permitting, and the guided Ibex Trail as winter-only, weather permitting. Confirm actual availability with the operator.

culture-cycles.note: Read directly: named-site seasonal/weekly calendars, not governorate-wide public holidays or confirmation that sites are open despite weather or emergency notices. Table does not define summer dates and has overlapping April headings. Reserve spans Karak and Madaba; no fixed calendar dates or access assurance inferred.
